repositories.name: Design Resources for Developers
repositories.learningValue: Curated map of free design resources for developers
caveats: Every linked external resource has its own terms

repositories.name: Awesome Design Tools
repositories.learningValue: Broad overview of product-design tools and workflows
caveats: A listed product may be paid or discontinued; the list license does not license linked products

repositories.name: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
repositories.learningValue: Normative-quality interaction patterns, keyboard behavior and accessible examples
caveats: Examples teach patterns and still require testing with real assistive technologies

repositories.name: Carbon Design System
repositories.learningValue: Large-scale design-system architecture, tokens, components and motion guidance
caveats: Brand assets and IBM trademarks are not granted by the code license

repositories.name: React Spectrum
repositories.learningValue: Reference implementation for accessible cross-platform component behavior
caveats: Adobe branding and example assets may have separate rights

repositories.name: Fluent UI
repositories.learningValue: Enterprise component architecture and interaction patterns
caveats: Microsoft trademarks and branded assets are separate from the MIT code

repositories.name: Primer React
repositories.learningValue: Production design-system patterns used in GitHub interfaces
caveats: Do not copy GitHub branding or product identity

repositories.name: Material Web
repositories.learningValue: Material component implementation and design-token architecture
caveats: Material trademarks and some design assets are governed separately

repositories.name: Open UI
repositories.license: W3C Software and Document License; W3C 3-Clause BSD for test suites
repositories.learningValue: Browser-level research on interoperable UI controls and behaviors
caveats: Specifications are evolving and are not a drop-in component library

repositories.name: Motion source, docs and examples
repositories.learningValue: Modern animation architecture, layout transitions and gesture patterns
caveats: Motion+ paid examples are excluded

repositories.name: Anime.js examples
repositories.learningValue: Readable examples of timelines, easing, staggering and SVG motion
caveats: Demo media and fonts must be checked separately

repositories.name: AutoAnimate
repositories.learningValue: Minimal enhancement pattern for DOM layout changes
caveats: Respect reduced motion even when the library animates automatically

repositories.name: Lenis
repositories.learningValue: Modern smooth-scroll implementation and scroll-event integration
caveats: Never use by default; verify keyboard scrolling, anchors, find-in-page and reduced motion

repositories.name: Locomotive Scroll
repositories.learningValue: Scroll observation, progress values and data-driven parallax patterns
caveats: Smooth-scroll behavior can harm accessibility and native navigation

repositories.name: AOS
repositories.learningValue: Simple declarative reveal-on-scroll patterns
caveats: Avoid hiding essential content before JavaScript initializes

repositories.name: Barba.js
repositories.learningValue: Page-transition lifecycle and progressive navigation patterns
caveats: Preserve focus, history, announcements and deep-link behavior

repositories.name: lottie-web
repositories.learningValue: Runtime architecture for exported vector animation
caveats: Animation JSON and embedded artwork retain their own rights

repositories.name: Swiper
repositories.learningValue: Touch interaction, virtual slides, accessibility and layered transition effects
caveats: Carousels require keyboard, pause and readable non-drag controls

repositories.name: tsParticles
repositories.learningValue: Configurable particle systems, emitters and interaction patterns
caveats: Cap density and disable or simplify under reduced motion

repositories.name: Motion Canvas
repositories.learningValue: Programmatic scene composition, signals, timelines and reusable animation components
caveats: Fonts, audio and imported media need separate licenses

repositories.name: Parallax.js
repositories.learningValue: Layered pointer and device-orientation parallax implementation
caveats: Provide touch and reduced-motion fallbacks; device-orientation permission varies

repositories.name: Rellax
repositories.learningValue: Small, readable scroll-parallax implementation
caveats: Treat as a legacy reference and test modern browser behavior

repositories.name: simpleParallax.js
repositories.learningValue: Focused image-parallax API with straightforward examples
caveats: Avoid large offscreen images and excessive scale factors

repositories.name: Atropos
repositories.learningValue: Layered 3D tilt and parallax for cards and media
caveats: Do not make core actions depend on tilt or hover

repositories.name: WebGL Fundamentals
repositories.learningValue: Progressive lessons from raw WebGL setup through lighting, textures and scene graphs
caveats: Third-party images and translations may include separate notices

repositories.name: WebGL2 Fundamentals
repositories.learningValue: Modern raw WebGL2 lessons and reusable mental models
caveats: Check asset notices before copying example media

repositories.name: Three.js Fundamentals
repositories.learningValue: Structured Three.js curriculum covering cameras, lighting, materials, loaders and performance
caveats: Example assets and translations may have separate attribution

repositories.name: WebGL2 Examples
repositories.learningValue: Single-file implementations of real rendering algorithms in raw WebGL2
caveats: Examples optimize for readability rather than production architecture

repositories.name: shader-school
repositories.learningValue: Interactive exercises for shader fundamentals
caveats: Older toolchain; use the concepts rather than pinning legacy dependencies

repositories.name: awesome-webgl
repositories.learningValue: Curated discovery map for WebGL libraries, articles, tutorials and tools
caveats: Every linked project has its own license and maintenance status

repositories.name: regl
repositories.learningValue: Functional abstraction over WebGL with a large example collection
caveats: Demo assets must be checked separately

repositories.name: luma.gl
repositories.learningValue: Production GPU abstractions and migration path toward WebGPU
caveats: Match examples to the installed major version

repositories.name: Three.js docs and examples
repositories.learningValue: Canonical implementation, manual, API docs and comprehensive examples
caveats: Example media can have separate notices; use the version matching the project

repositories.name: React Three Fiber docs and examples
repositories.learningValue: Declarative Three.js architecture, render-loop hooks and React integration
caveats: Showcase projects can have their own authors and licenses

repositories.name: WebGL Sandbox
repositories.learningValue: Compact interactive GLSL editor with audio and MIDI inputs
caveats: Small project; audit dependencies before production use

repositories.name: SHADERed
repositories.learningValue: Shader IDE, debugger and examples useful for understanding GPU pipelines
caveats: Desktop OpenGL tooling; porting shaders to WebGL may require syntax and feature changes

repositories.name: Three.js Examples by Yuri Sulyma
repositories.learningValue: Small runnable Three.js projects for mathematical and visual experimentation
caveats: Reference examples may target older Three.js releases
